text:
mia: alert: multiple customers reporting 503s starting ~20:03 UTC, spike correlated with hosted inference pool 'hotpool-3'

mia: symptoms: upstream inference workers repeatedly exit with OOM / segfault, then k8s restarts -> gateway 503s. customer: AcmeCorp saw 30% request failures in 10m window :grimacing:

mia: initial log snippet:
```
2024-02-15T20:02:41Z infer-runner[pid=2345]: nvml: out of memory on device 0 (GPU 0)
2024-02-15T20:02:41Z infer-runner[pid=2345]: cgroup: memory+swap exceeded, OOMKill
2024-02-15T20:02:42Z infer-runner[pid=2345]: segfault at 0x7ff... attention_cuda.cu:SIGSEGV
```

raj: seeing the same on our side, autoscaler aggressively scaled down hotpool-3 earlier due to a spike in idle count at 19:58 -> nodes terminated, pods migrated. suspect race between kill + KV prefetch causing memory balloon on rescheduled pods.

jessica: can we confirm if this is linked to recent dynbatch change? I rolled out dynbatch 1.3.4 yesterday.

leo: I replayed the request stream against a repro harness; when a pod is started cold and receives large prefix+kvcache prefetch, memory climbs and cgroups trigger OOM within ~12s. Repro steps:
- start pod with default batch_limit=64
- send 3 concurrent requests with ctx_len=60k each
- observe memory spike and kernel SIGSEGV after prefetch

mia: mitigation idea: temporarily set autoscaler.min_replicas=hotpool-3:6 and disable scale-to-zero for 1 hour; reduce default batch_limit to 32 for hosted pool.

cs-bot: Noted — CS notified AcmeCorp and offered rollback window. Acme asks for ETA and rollback plan.

raj: quick hotfix: pushed scale override and rolled back dynbatch to 1.3.3 on hotpool-3 at 20:15 UTC. Also applied runtime env var: INFER_PREFETCH_THRESHOLD=0.8 -> reduces aggressive prefetch.

deploy-bot: rollouts: dynbatch rollback to 1.3.3 completed on hotpool-3 (deploy id: deploy-20240215-2048); scale override applied.

jessica: logs after rollback show no new segfaults in last 12m, 503 rate back down to baseline.

mia: follow-ups:
- eng-runtime: add prefetch safety check to avoid allocating >80% device mem on coldstart (owner: raj)
- eng-sre: tune autoscaler policy to respect in-flight prefetch (owner: leo)
- product/cs: update AcmeCorp with postmortem and credit for request failures (owner: jessica)

leo: recording repro artifacts in incident tracker: s3://redwood-incidents/1711352468/repro.tar.gz

mia: assigning follow-up meeting 45m to coordinate CFT + CS. tagging @jessica to own customer comms.

jessica: ack, will send note in 30 mins with timeline and next steps. :thumbsup:

mia: thanks team. closing on-call loop when CS confirms customer is stable. :white_check_mark:
